description: A request for a human decision: heading, description, a localized risk badge, a host-supplied preview and key/value details, an optional countdown to the deadline, and Approve / Reject actions with an optional note. It is a controlled component - the host owns State and hears every transition through StateChanged - and it leaves the pending state only after OnDecision completes without throwing, so a failed save is reported in a TmAlert and the request stays decidable. A decided card collapses into a single row that names who decided and when; with UndoWindow it also offers Undo until that window elapses. One polite live region carries every announcement, the ticking countdown is aria-live="off", and the Ctrl/Cmd shortcuts only fire while focus is inside the card and never from inside the note field.

parameters.name: AllowNote
parameters.description: Whether the optional note field is offered at all. Default is true; the field is always rendered when RequireNoteOnReject is set.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the group when Title is omitted. Defaults to a localized "Approval request".

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: Compact
parameters.description: Renders the condensed single-row variant: no description, preview or details, with the heading, risk, countdown and actions on one line. Default is false.

parameters.name: DecidedAt
parameters.description: Moment of the decision, shown in the collapsed row. When omitted the moment the decision was raised is used.

parameters.name: DecidedBy
parameters.description: Display name of the person who decided, shown in the collapsed row. When omitted the row says "Unknown".

parameters.name: DecisionNote
parameters.description: Note to show in the collapsed row. When omitted the note typed by the decider is used, so a host that does not echo it still shows what was written.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Free-text description of what is being approved.

parameters.name: Details
parameters.description: Key/value details of the request, rendered as a definition list. Hidden in Compact mode.

parameters.name: EnableShortcuts
parameters.description: Whether the Ctrl/Cmd+Enter (approve) and Ctrl/Cmd+Backspace (reject) shortcuts are active while focus is inside the card. Default is true; the card never reacts to those keys typed in the note field.

parameters.name: ExpiresAt
parameters.description: Deadline of the request. While the card is pending the remaining time is shown as a countdown; once it elapses the state becomes Expired and the actions are disabled.

parameters.name: OnDecision
parameters.description: Callback that persists the decision. The card stays Pending while it runs (actions disabled, card aria-busy); when it throws, the error is shown in a TmAlert and the request stays decidable.

parameters.name: OnUndo
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the user undoes a decision. It runs first and, when it succeeds, the card returns to Pending; a throw keeps the decision and shows the localized error. Undo is offered only when this callback (or Undone) is wired.

parameters.name: PreviewContent
parameters.description: Host-rendered preview of the thing being approved (a document excerpt, a diff, a summary of the pending change). Hidden in Compact mode.

parameters.name: RequireNoteOnReject
parameters.description: When true a rejection without a note is refused: the note field is marked aria-invalid, the reason is announced and the decision is not raised. Default is false.

parameters.name: Risk
parameters.description: Risk level shown as a localized badge and as the card's accent. Default is ApprovalRisk.Low.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: Current state of the request. Default is ApprovalState.Pending.

parameters.name: StateChanged
parameters.description: Raised whenever the card transitions state - a decision, the automatic expiry and Undo. Use it with @bind-State.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Heading of the request. When omitted the group is named by AriaLabel (or a localized default) and no heading is rendered.

parameters.name: UndoWindow
parameters.description: How long after a decision the collapsed row offers Undo. When null (the default) or zero, no Undo is offered; the window starts at the moment the decision was raised.

parameters.name: Undone
parameters.description: Raised together with OnUndo for hosts that prefer an EventCallback.

methods.name: ApproveAsync
methods.description: Approves the request: runs OnDecision and, on success, leaves the pending state. A no-op when the request is not decidable.

methods.name: RejectAsync
methods.description: Rejects the request. When RequireNoteOnReject is set and the note is blank, the request stays pending and the note field is marked invalid.

methods.name: UndoAsync
methods.description: Withdraws the last decision while the undo window is open: OnUndo / Undone runs and, when it succeeds, the card returns to Pending and focus returns to the primary action. A failing undo keeps the decision. A no-op once the window has elapsed.

examples.title: Approval request with a deadline, details and an undo window
examples.code:
<TmApprovalCard Title="Release the invoice"
                Description="The requester wants the invoice sent today."
                Risk="ApprovalRisk.High"
                Details="@details"
                ExpiresAt="@deadline"
                RequireNoteOnReject="true"
                UndoWindow="TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30)"
                OnDecision="@SubmitAsync"
                OnUndo="@WithdrawAsync"
                @bind-State="state" />

examples.title: Compact row inside a decision inbox
examples.code:
<TmApprovalCard Title="Refund order #1042"
                Risk="ApprovalRisk.Medium"
                Compact="true"
                ExpiresAt="@inTwoHours"
                OnDecision="@SubmitAsync" />
